description:
Port pi-mono utils/oauth/anthropic.ts (PKCE, callback server via Plug/Bandit, token exchange, refresh) + cli.ts (auth.json storage). Add `mix octo_pi.auth` that runs the flow and stores tokens.

Deferred — only becomes necessary if the user wants to use octo_pi without having Claude Code installed. With opi-y1y.1 + .2 landing, the keychain-first path covers most users.

Test reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/ai/test/anthropic-oauth.test.ts.
title: Full OAuth login flow + refresh + storage + mix task
